title: Cesc Santasusana
html:
Former member of Kamailio (OpenSER) Management board.

Cesc Santasusana substantially contributed to TLS support in Kamailio (OpenSER). His efforts were directed to promote the open source SIP server and travel to project public events.

Contact: Cesc’s blog
